__comment__: PINE PITCH GLUE: Neolithic hafting glue, 10,000 BCE - still used. Composition: rosin (adhesive matrix, 60%), charcoal powder (filler, increases viscosity, reduces brittleness, 20%), tallow/beeswax (plasticizer, prevents cracking, 20%). Heated to 120C, mixed, applied hot. Hardens on cooling to strong but slightly flexible bond. The actual glue that held stone heads before cordage.
